audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all four Animal Shop events: Marnie’s Cave Carrot request, Shane’s collapse and recovery scenes, and his blue-hen barn scene. Every line, overhead reaction, conditional branch, mental-health meaning, character voice, animal term, and Joja reference was reviewed in full event context with canonical Marnie, Shane, Jas, Charlie, Cave Carrot and Joja terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and quest conditions, honorific and gender selectors, placeholders, quoted temporary-actor identifiers, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
